prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Name your pet..."]
1: ["Welcome to Your Desktop!", "Your companion is ready to inhabit your desktop screen.", "Desktop Pet Controls", "Quick key shortcuts and desktop interaction settings.", "Press Alt+P to show or hide pet instantly", "Got It!"]
2: ["Save Your Selected Pet", "Sign in to keep your companion synced across sessions and devices."]
3: ["Verifying Display & Overlay Permissions", "Checking window rendering permissions..."]
4: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Log in with your existing account to recover previously adopted pets and maintain cloud synchronization.", "Use the same email you registered with previously."]
5: ["Upload Pet Photo", "Well-lit photos with clear subject backgrounds yield best creation results.", "High Contrast Lighting Recommended"]
6: ["Select Your Adoption Path", "Pick a ready-made preset companion or upload photos to build a unique custom pet."]
7: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "Estimated wait time: ~45 seconds"]
8: ["Welcome Gift Unlocked!", "Your new pet comes with a complimentary starter bell collar.", "Claimed: Starter Collar Accessory"]
9: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Complete 3 simple steps to spawn your interactive companion."]
